_description: Historical single-sequence mode starting 1966. Tests that returnModel='historical_single' walks the recorded S&P 500 / 10-yr Treasury series in calendar order, paired with that year's CPI. 1966-1970 captures the start of the late-60s/early-70s stagflation that historically destroyed early-Trinity-era retirees.
_rationale: Pure accumulation: $500k Roth (tax-free), no spending, no income, no inflation in the cash-flow path. Each year's portfolio factor is `0.6 * stockFactor + 0.4 * bondFactor` from HISTORICAL_RETURNS for 1966-1970. With no withdrawals, the path is the running product of those blended factors. probability=100 because nothing can deplete a balance with zero spending.
name: Historical 1966 Stagflation Start
